title: Aptean
description: aptean.com Many terabytes of data and also your clients Aptean, Inc. — private PE-backed global ERP software vendor founded 2012 in Alpharetta, GA (merger of CDC Software + Consona), ~$945M revenue (ZoomInfo est., $804M UK group accounts 2025), 3-5K employees, 10,000+ customers in 80+ countries. Owned by TA Associates (lead), Insight Partners, Charlesbank, Clearlake Capital after Vista's 2022 exit; valued $3.55B (2022). Buys vertical software companies aggressively — 60+ acquisitions since 2015 ($2B spent 2019-2025), including Logility (Nasdaq take-private, $14.30/share, 2025), Germanedge, JobRouter, Momentis, SSG Insight, Indigo. Portfolio: industry-specific ERP (food & beverage, discrete/process manufacturing, fashion, distribution), SCM, WMS, TMS, EAM, dealer management, on the AI-native AppCentral platform. CEO TVN Reddy (ex-ADP, Wharton MBA) since 2018.
